keep: The palette roles, type pairing, and spacing rhythm — the design language, not the pixels.
Component vocabulary hints (buttons, cards, nav) as a checklist, not as markup.
replace: All copy, imagery, logos, and distinctive artwork with the customer's own content.
Fonts with licensed equivalents unless the source font is verifiably self-hostable.
remix: Shift the accent hue by roughly 10 degrees and pick the customer's own brand neutrals — visibly theirs, not a copy.
Let the customer's real content (products, posts, pages) drive the layout; apply the language to it.
adaptation.licensingNote: Inspired-by analysis: no source CSS, HTML, copy, or assets were copied. Verify the source license before any closer adaptation.

pins.why: Elementor scopes this band's pull to a device range: flush on desktop, 170px on tablet, 100px on mobile.
This band's container is Elementor's 1600px wide, not the 1140px default — extraction reads the default. Cards are 25% of it.
The source cards are borderless media cards: 10px widget-wrap padding, no column gutter, 40px-padded text block — measured, not band-scoped CSS.
The catalogue band keeps 100px of bottom air under the button.
Muted footer text on the dark footer bar.
The services rows are Auxin advanced-text widgets: 36px/50px inner padding, an 81px unfilled icon circle with a 45px glyph, and 27px/32px titles — measured live, not band-scoped CSS.

The source body renders at 16px: the body element computes 16.0016px and 1335 of ~1771 body characters are 16px. 16 is absent from the px ladder because the source inherits it as a relative size, so the band heuristic picks 13px.
The source scopes this band padding to a device range: 125px on desktop, 100px on tablet and mobile. A single shorthand forced 125px everywhere and over-padded tablet/mobile by 25px.
